navigation: Arrows / D-pad: select - Enter / A: confirm
name_help: Enter: save - Esc / B: return without saving
storage_error: Cannot save. Enter: retry - Esc / B: menu.
invalid_name: Use letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens or underscores.
physics_details: Invalid geometry. See the technical log for details.
shock_warning: SHOCK {seconds}s: leave the edge and capture!
scores_error: Leaderboard unavailable - Enter: retry - Esc / B: menu
shield_help: Space / X: activate - absorbs one contact
tutorial_lines: Arrows, stick or D-pad: continuous orthogonal movement.
Follow the edges: captured interiors cannot be crossed.
Enter the open field and close a line to capture territory.
Start with {lives} lives. Win with at least {extra}%: one extra life.
A single cut claiming at least {shield}% of the field earns a shield.
Space / X: pink shield, protects from one enemy contact.
From level 5, two shocks travel in opposite directions. Move!
After level 12: save or continue a harder cycle.
hint_01: Close short cuts and return to the edge: your line is vulnerable.
hint_02: Missiles target your launch-time position: safe territory absorbs them.
hint_03: The boss pursues open cuts: watch its direction before leaving.
hint_04: Plan your exit before cutting; take advantage of the slow boss turns.
hint_05: Two perimeter shocks now circle in opposite directions.
hint_06: Large single captures earn shields; press Space or X to equip one.
hint_07: Stay on the frontier and keep your next safe exit in sight.
hint_08: Missiles are faster: avoid long exposed cuts.
hint_09: A shield absorbs one contact, but cannot repair a crossed line.
hint_10: Shocks activate earlier. Capture territory to reset them.
hint_11: Look for a broad capture that clears the victory threshold.
hint_12: Finish the campaign, then save or try a harder cycle.
debug_help: Up/Down: field - Left/Right: value - Enter: start - Esc: cancel
respawn_release: Release direction, then press to move again
